## What's wrong?

A clear description of the issue — typo, broken link, outdated content, missing section, or unclear explanation.

## Location

Where in the documentation is the problem? Include the page URL or file path.

- **Page:** 
- **File path:** 

## Suggestion

If you have a suggested fix, include it here. If not, just describe what's wrong and someone will look at it.

## Notes

Any additional context — screenshots, related pages, or why this matters.
